nodes.label: delivery_offers table

nodes.label: Drop-off Geofence with Confirm Delivered

nodes.label: Delivery Failure Cases

nodes.label: Fast Delivery (priority dispatch)

nodes.label: Final Independent State Model
nodes.rationale: Separate state sets for group order, restaurant order, delivery, item, payment and rider offer make the Laravel implementation more reliable than one orders.status field.

nodes.label: GPS Integrity / Spoof Detection
nodes.rationale: Combine distance, time, speed, accuracy, timestamp and continuity; flag implausible speed as suspicious and collect evidence rather than accusing the rider.

nodes.label: Group Order
nodes.rationale: Checkout is one Group Order that spawns independent Restaurant Orders, each with its own delivery fee, rider and delivery; tourist sees one order, backend runs each restaurant fulfillment as an independent operational unit.

nodes.label: 12-Phase Implementation Order
nodes.rationale: Build incrementally: order foundation, financials, eligibility, dispatch, preparation, pickup, tracking, GPS integrity (after tracking works), drop-off, COD settlement, earnings, PayMongo payout.

nodes.label: Instant Cash Out (async PayMongo payout)
nodes.rationale: Payout state is asynchronous (EARNED->AVAILABLE->CASHOUT_REQUESTED->PROCESSING->PAID); API success is not money received; store provider reference.

nodes.label: Item-Level Status Derives Restaurant Readiness
nodes.rationale: Restaurant order becomes READY only when all its items are ready; computed from items to avoid inconsistent manual states and rider waiting.

nodes.label: Per-Delivery Tips (20-100 PHP)
nodes.rationale: Tip tied to the specific restaurant delivery since each restaurant has its own rider.

nodes.label: Per-Restaurant Delivery Fee Calculation
nodes.rationale: Delivery fee is computed per restaurant order by distance since pickup points differ even when drop-off is the same.

nodes.label: Pickup Geofence with Manual Confirm
nodes.rationale: 50-100m radius triggers an arrival alert only; the Confirm Pickup button is the actual transition.

nodes.label: 20% Platform Commission (Financial Ledger)
nodes.rationale: Platform share must not be mixed into rider credits; delivery fee, restaurant proceeds, commission and rider earnings are distinct concepts recorded in a ledger.

nodes.label: Preparation Time Prediction
nodes.rationale: Record preparation_started_at and ready_at to compute actual_preparation_seconds; use prediction only with enough history, else default; improves dispatch timing.

nodes.label: Restaurant Order
nodes.rationale: One restaurant gets one order even with multiple menu items; carries its own subtotal, delivery_fee, total, status, payment_status, rider_id.

nodes.label: Rider Credit Ledger
nodes.rationale: Replace a mutable rider.credit number with transactions (TOP_UP, COD_RESERVATION, COD_SETTLEMENT, COD_RELEASE, ADJUSTMENT, REFUND) for auditability.

nodes.label: Nearest-Eligible Rider Dispatch
nodes.rationale: Filter eligible riders, sort by Haversine distance rider->restaurant, offer sequentially.

nodes.label: rider_locations table
nodes.rationale: Keep location history rather than overwriting, with integrity_status per point.

nodes.label: Rider Offer Ping with Expiry
nodes.rationale: Offer expires (e.g. 30s); reject or timeout moves to next eligible rider.

nodes.norm_label: role-specific notifications (rider floating alert, restaurant ops, tourist tracking)

nodes.norm_label: websocket event catalog (dispatch, restaurant, pickup, tracking, drop-off, payment)

nodes.label: Atomic Rider Assignment (race-condition lock)
nodes.rationale: Lock the delivery record in a DB transaction so only one rider can accept an OFFERED delivery.

nodes.label: COD Credit Reservation (not deduction)
nodes.rationale: Treat the 200 PHP reserve as required available credit; reserve at assignment, settle on success, release on failure, preventing a rider from exceeding financial capacity across simultaneous COD orders.

nodes.label: Just-in-Time Rider Arrival
nodes.rationale: Time dispatch so rider arrives near food readiness (2-3 min buffer) to avoid riders waiting.

nodes.label: Device-Side GPS Queue / Offline Buffering
nodes.rationale: GPS jumps after connectivity loss are not automatically spoofing; queue samples locally and replay so the server can reconstruct movement.

nodes.label: Per-Delivery cash_due
nodes.rationale: Biggest business-logic issue: with multi-restaurant COD, each rider collects only their delivery's cash_due (subtotal+fee+tip-discount), never the group total.

nodes.label: Order Item Price Snapshot
nodes.rationale: Snapshot unit_price and item name at checkout so later menu price changes do not alter existing orders.

nodes.label: Rider Earnings Separate from Rider Credit
nodes.norm_label: rider earnings separate from rider credit
nodes.rationale: Credit supports COD eligibility/settlement; earnings are money earned; they are not the same wallet.

nodes.rationale: Acts as central regulatory authority, not just an approver: approves businesses and riders, verifies permits, monitors activity, handles disputes.

nodes.label: Track-Tour Entity Relationship Diagram
nodes.rationale: Normalized schema covering users, businesses, addresses, staff, menus, orders, rooms, bookings, riders, trips, payments, reviews and audit logs.

nodes.label: Frontend Design System (Poppins, Tailwind, tourism palette)
nodes.norm_label: frontend design system (poppins, tailwind, tourism palette)
nodes.rationale: Glassmorphism-inspired, Oriental Mindoro tourism palette (Banana Gold #FFD700, Verdant Leaf #2E8B57, Tablas Azure #1E90FF, Earthy Clay #8B5A2B, Plaza Glow #FF4500); sidebar+topbar layout; bottom nav on mobile.

nodes.label: Track-Tour Tourism Promotion Platform
nodes.rationale: Centralizes tourism services (discovery, accommodation, food, transport, payments) in one ecosystem for tourists, local businesses, riders and the Tourism Office.

nodes.label: Hybrid Cost-Optimized Real-Time Tracking Architecture
nodes.rationale: MySQL for persistent data, Firebase RTDB only for ephemeral live coordinates during an active trip (trip-scoped /trips/{trip_id} node deleted on completion, GPS pushed every 5-10s), WebSockets for low-frequency status events. Minimizes Firebase cost; answers the panel question 'why two databases?'.

nodes.label: Multi-Business Ownership Model
nodes.rationale: One owner account can own many businesses, each operating independently with its own staff, menu, rooms, bookings, orders and reports.

nodes.label: MVP-First Scope Strategy
nodes.rationale: Full feature list is semester-sized; build an end-to-end MVP first (auth, business registration, food ordering, room booking, one payment flow, basic rider tracking) and treat staff sub-roles, reviews and analytics as stretch goals.

nodes.label: Polymorphic Payments Table (payable_type/payable_id)
nodes.rationale: One payments table serves orders, bookings and trips.

nodes.label: Recommended Build Order
nodes.rationale: Start with Authentication & RBAC because every other module depends on secure accounts and role permissions.

nodes.label: room_availability Table
nodes.rationale: Per-date availability instead of a boolean field to prevent double-booking, support peak season and generate occupancy reports.

nodes.label: Three-Tier Hybrid System Architecture
nodes.rationale: Separates presentation, application and data layers for scalability, maintainability and security; modules can be added without redesign.

nodes.label: Auto-cancel Coverage Widened to Transport (D4)
nodes.rationale: Rides only inherited auto-cancel because they were mislabeled; the fix must not silently drop it.

nodes.label: One-Time Ride Destination Change
nodes.rationale: Same trip updated in place so there is no second booking; previews and refused confirms don't use the change.

nodes.label: Rider Confirms Ride Payment Before Completing
nodes.norm_label: rider confirms ride payment before completing
nodes.rationale: Server refuses completion without the rider's confirmation and refuses an unpaid GCash ride.

nodes.label: Ride Final Fare (verified GPS distance, capped at estimate x 1.15)
nodes.norm_label: ride final fare (verified gps distance, capped at estimate x 1.15)
nodes.rationale: Jitter, impossible jumps, gaps and an early end are never charged; insufficient evidence flags needs_review.

nodes.label: Server-Authoritative Ride Fare
nodes.rationale: Fare, distance and duration re-derived from coordinates in createRide(), ignoring client values; OSRM is preview-only.
